headline: Sensex and Nifty extend rally as Nykaa and Sundaram Finance report strong Q2 results; Nifty crosses 23,900

marketStatus.message: Market is open for trading today.

why: Strong corporate earnings from companies like Nykaa and Sundaram Finance boosted investor confidence
The return of Foreign Institutional Investors (FIIs) and softening crude oil prices supported market sentiment
India's services sector activity hit a four-month high in October as business conditions improved
The Indian rupee strengthened by 17 paise to settle at 94.58 against the U.S. dollar
whatHappening: The Sensex jumped 384 points while the Nifty 50 settled above the 23,900 level
Nykaa reported a 207% year-on-year surge in net profit and announced an 82% stake acquisition in Simply Nam
Bharat Electronics (BEL) and Titan were among the top gainers, with both stocks rising 4%
Global cues, including US midterm election results and a rally in European shares, influenced domestic trading
summary: Indian markets extended their winning streak on November 4, with the Nifty closing above 23,900 driven by robust Q2 earnings and positive economic data. Nykaa and Sundaram Finance led the corporate news with significant profit growth, while BEL and Titan saw 4% gains. Easing oil prices and a strengthening rupee further contributed to the bullish sentiment despite mixed global cues.
